parameters.query:
SELECT 
  DATE(cl.date) AS date,
  cl.user_id AS agent,
  ccd.sourcesofcomplaint,
  COUNT(*) AS CaseLogged
FROM call_complaint_log cl
INNER JOIN call_complaint cc ON cc.id = cl.pro_complaint_id
INNER JOIN call_complaint_details ccd ON ccd.id = cc.complaint_id
WHERE cc.date >= '{{ $('Calculate Date Range Nihon1').first().json.startDate }}'
AND cc.date <= '{{ $('Calculate Date Range Nihon1').first().json.endDate }}'
AND cl.user_id IN ('Prince', 'Sachin', 'Somansh', 'yakoob', 'Anish')
AND cl.id = (
  SELECT MIN(cl2.id) 
  FROM call_complaint_log cl2 
  WHERE cl2.pro_complaint_id = cl.pro_complaint_id
)
GROUP BY DATE(cl.date), cl.user_id, ccd.sourcesofcomplaint
ORDER BY DATE(cl.date) ASC, cl.user_id ASC;

SELECT 
  DATE(cl.date) AS date,
  cl.user_id AS agent,
  COUNT(*) AS CasesClosed
FROM call_complaint_log cl
WHERE cl.date >= '{{ $('Calculate Date Range Nihon1').first().json.startDate }}'
AND cl.date <= '{{ $('Calculate Date Range Nihon1').first().json.endDate }}'
AND cl.complaint_status = 'Resolved'
AND cl.user_id IN ('Prince', 'Sachin', 'Somansh', 'yakoob', 'Anish')
GROUP BY DATE(cl.date), cl.user_id
ORDER BY DATE(cl.date) ASC, cl.user_id ASC

SELECT 
  DATE(rl.created) AS date,
  rl.userid AS agent,
  COUNT(*) AS Reassigned
FROM call_reassign_engineer_logs rl
WHERE rl.created >= '{{ $('Calculate Date Range Nihon1').first().json.startDate }}'
AND rl.created <= '{{ $('Calculate Date Range Nihon1').first().json.endDate }}'
AND rl.userid IN ('Prince', 'Sachin', 'Somansh', 'yakoob', 'Anish')
GROUP BY DATE(rl.created), rl.userid
ORDER BY DATE(rl.created) ASC, rl.userid ASC

SELECT 
  DATE(cl.date) AS date,
  cl.user_id AS agent,
  COUNT(*) AS CaseLoggedCall
FROM call_complaint_log cl
INNER JOIN call_complaint cc ON cc.id = cl.pro_complaint_id
INNER JOIN call_complaint_details ccd ON ccd.id = cc.complaint_id
WHERE cl.date >= '{{ $('Calculate Date Range Nihon1').first().json.startDate }}'
AND cl.date <= '{{ $('Calculate Date Range Nihon1').first().json.endDate }}'
AND cl.user_id IN ('Prince', 'Sachin', 'Somansh', 'yakoob', 'Anish')
AND ccd.sourcesofcomplaint = 'Call'
AND cl.id = (
  SELECT MIN(cl2.id) 
  FROM call_complaint_log cl2 
  WHERE cl2.pro_complaint_id = cl.pro_complaint_id
)
GROUP BY DATE(cl.date), cl.user_id
ORDER BY DATE(cl.date) ASC, cl.user_id ASC;

parameters.query:
SELECT DATE(c.created_on) AS date, u.name AS agent, cp.source_of_complaint AS source, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM complaints c
JOIN complainants cp ON cp.id = c.complainant_id
JOIN users u ON u.id = c.created_by
WHERE c.created_by IN (142, 159, 211)
AND c.created_on >= '{{ $('Calculate Date Range Nihon1').first().json.startDate }}'
AND c.created_on <= '{{ $('Calculate Date Range Nihon1').first().json.endDate }}'
AND cp.source_of_complaint IN ('Phone','Email')
GROUP BY DATE(c.created_on), u.name, cp.source_of_complaint
ORDER BY date ASC, u.name ASC;

SELECT DATE(cl.date) AS date, cl.user_id AS agent, COUNT(*) AS CaseUpdate
FROM call_complaint_log cl
JOIN (SELECT pro_complaint_id, MIN(id) AS min_id FROM call_complaint_log GROUP BY pro_complaint_id) first_log
  ON first_log.pro_complaint_id = cl.pro_complaint_id
WHERE cl.user_id IN ('Prince','Sachin','Somansh','yakoob','Anish')
  AND cl.id <> first_log.min_id
  AND cl.complaint_status <> 'Resolved'
  AND cl.date >= '{{ $('Calculate Date Range Nihon1').first().json.startDate }}'
  AND cl.date <= '{{ $('Calculate Date Range Nihon1').first().json.endDate }}'
GROUP BY DATE(cl.date), cl.user_id
ORDER BY date ASC, agent ASC;

SELECT DATE(cl.created_on) AS date, u.name AS agent, COUNT(*) AS CaseUpdate
FROM complaintlogs cl
JOIN (SELECT complaint_id, MIN(id) AS min_id FROM complaintlogs GROUP BY complaint_id) first_log
  ON first_log.complaint_id = cl.complaint_id
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = cl.created_by
WHERE cl.created_by IN (142,159,211)
  AND cl.id <> first_log.min_id
  AND cl.status NOT IN ('Closed','Resolved')
  AND cl.created_on >= '{{ $('Calculate Date Range Nihon1').first().json.startDate }}'
  AND cl.created_on <= '{{ $('Calculate Date Range Nihon1').first().json.endDate }}'
GROUP BY DATE(cl.created_on), u.name
ORDER BY date ASC, u.name ASC;
